liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **All Along the Watchtower** (2 reviews): Reviewer believes this was the first east coast performance of Watchtower; Crowd was excited for this first east coast Watchtower [14][18]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Jerry plays a well-formed line, but Brent seems subdued; a 50-second pause followed as the crowd wanted Phil [23]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Reviewer hears a rough Walkin' Blues [23]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Reviewer vividly remembers Dire Wolf, part of the newer material in the middle of a long first set [15]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Jerry was beaming with a smile just as he started China Cat [19]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The wah effect on He's Gone is singled out as especially cool [24]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): Encore Black Muddy River had a man dancing on a truck until the end [25]

## The recordings

- **gd87-07-02.sbd.nawrocki.6473.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 153 min; rated 4/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: Composite recording has too much audience mic and sounds on the verge of feeding back; Reviewer feels the recording could be better [16][18]
- **gd1987-07-02.170974.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 157 min [4]
- **gd1987-07-02.167358.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 153 min [6]
- **gd1987-07-02.beyer.connor.tetzeli.fix-22057.35441.reflac.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 158 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: This source is somewhat thin, and its pitch was originally quite high [7]
- **gd87-07-02.beyerm88.connor.22057.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 25 songs; 154 min; rated 3.73/5 by 14 [8]. Said about its sound: Sounds like a frequently traded good soundboard, but not at the quality of Without a Net [24]

## Around the show

- Fans danced atop Genesee beer trucks under overcast skies; the reviewer recalls wandering the neighborhoods around the stadium [14]
- Reviewer drove through blinding rain, arriving as Bertha moved into Walkin' Blues; small minor league ballpark, band playing in the outfield, general admission [15]
- Old ballpark was much smaller than football stadiums; after the show it took hours to find the van [18]
- Reviewer camped overnight in the parking lot, got near the stage, and heard Paul Simon's Graceland over the PA before the show [19]
- First set was exceptionally long, twelve or thirteen songs [19]
- Night before, local Rochester radio broadcast the In The Dark album and the parking lot rocked with it [25]
- Only east coast show of that summer tour without Dylan, played in a small baseball stadium [14]
- Reviewer attended this and Foxboro; Foxboro was mediocre and not worth downloading, while this show is okay [20]
- Band sounded more energetic and confident here than a few days later at Foxboro [21]
- First set had energy but was less mischievous and blazing than the Dozin' at the Knick show [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd87-07-02.sbd.nawrocki.6473.sbefail.shnf**: source: update: Healy Ultramix > cass> DAT > CDR > EAC > addawav> CDWave > mkwACT [1]. Also: Lineage: Healy Ultramix to cassette, DAT, CDR, then EAC and further conversion; seeded by Doug Nawrocki [1]
- **gd1987-07-02.170974.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: A Nakamichi 300 source supplies a 0:23 patch in the Drums to Space transition [4]
- **gd1987-07-02.167358.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: A Nakamichi 304 source supplies a 0:14 patch in Space [6]
- **gd1987-07-02.beyer.connor.tetzeli.fix-22057.35441.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 22057 [7]. Also: Beyer-based source; pitch corrected track by track using generated reference tones in CE2K as a tuning fork [7]
- **gd87-07-02.beyerm88.connor.22057.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1 Ultramatrix seeded by Doug Nawrocki shnid 6473 Set 2 Beyer Dynamic M88's>Sony TCD5M>CM [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Silver Stadium - July 2, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-2-1987) [27]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Silver Stadium - July 2, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-2-1987) [28]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-07-02 Silver Stadium, Rochester, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-07-02-silver-stadium-rochester-ny-usa/) [29]
